sections.voiceover: Variety released its 2nd annual Horror Impact Report on October 7, 2026, crowning top directors and actors shaping modern horror.

Director James Wan was recognized in Variety's October 2026 Horror Impact Report as a key talent defining the genre. Director Na Hong-jin, known for the film Hope, was selected for the report alongside Sam Raimi. Who else made the list?
Except Curry Barker and Naomi Ackie also grabbed spots on Variety's list.
